How much is a used Ralph Lauren Polo Bear sweater worth?

Polo Bear knits are collectible: older and rarer designs sell for far more than a standard Ralph Lauren jumper.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The bear is knitted into the sweater (not printed) and comes in many outfits and themes. The label tells roughly how old it is: vintage pieces from the 1990s are especially sought after. Graphic hoodies and T-shirts with the bear are a cheaper, separate market.

What decides the price

  • Design: rare and vintage bear designs are worth much more than recent common ones.
  • Type: knitted sweaters above printed hoodies and T-shirts.
  • Size: adult sizes sell above kids' sizes.
  • Condition: holes, stains and pilling.

Check before you buy

  • Check the label and the knit quality: fakes exist.
  • Look for holes and stains, especially around the bear.
  • Search the exact bear design to see how common it is.

Where it sells best

Sells well on Vinted and eBay. Name the bear design in the title, collectors search for it.

Today's price

Prices for a used Ralph Lauren Polo Bear sweater change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Ralph Lauren Polo Bear sweater worth?

It depends on design, age, size and condition. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Polo Ralph Lauren Polo Bear sweater" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Why are Polo Bear sweaters so expensive?

They are collectible: designs change, older ones are scarce, and fans search for specific bears.

Is a Polo Bear hoodie worth as much as a knitted sweater?

No, printed hoodies and T-shirts sell for less than knitted bear sweaters.
